purpose: Decompose dense AGENTS.md into focused, single-purpose documents for faster information retrieval.
design_intent: Reduce cognitive load by separating concerns: architecture, operations, known issues, and quick-start references.
change_impact: Affects how developers navigate documentation - now has clear entry points per topic.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md is concise (< 100 lines) and serves as index
Focused docs exist for Architecture, Operations, Known Issues
No information loss from original AGENTS.md

deliverables.change: New quick-start guide with essential links
Operations guide: debug workflow, selector strategy, gap health
Reduced to concise index (~55 lines from 213)
